mods.name: DoorsReloaded
mods.description: Lightweight, modern door behavior for Fabric and Quilt.

releases.notes:
This release updates DoorsReloaded's **mod and plugin to Minecraft 26.3**, carrying forward the features, improvements, and fixes from 2.4.0.

## ✨ New Features & Changes

- ✅ **Minecraft 26.3 Support** - Updated both the Fabric/Quilt mod and Paper/Purpur/Folia plugin for Minecraft 26.3.
- ✅ **Updated Platform Dependencies** - Updated Fabric Loader, Fabric API, and the Paper API target for Minecraft 26.3.
- ✅ **Updated Platform Metadata** - Both platform jars now declare the correct Minecraft 26.3 compatibility requirements.

## 📦 Downloads

| Platform | File | Minecraft Version |
|----------|------|-------------------|
| Paper/Purpur/Folia | `DoorsReloaded-2.5.0-Paper.jar` | 26.3 |
| Fabric/Quilt | `DoorsReloaded-2.5.0-Fabric.jar` | 26.3 |

## 🔧 Technical Changes

- Updated Fabric Loader to `0.19.5`.
- Updated Fabric API to `0.161.0+26.3`.
- Updated the Paper API target to `26.3.build.177-stable`.
- Adapted Fabric gameplay permissions to the permission API included with Fabric API for Minecraft 26.3.
- Verified both platform builds and the existing regression tests against the Minecraft 26.3 targets.

## 📋 Compatibility Summary

- ✅ Paper 26.3
- ✅ Purpur 26.3
- ✅ Folia 26.3 (region-threading aware)
- ✅ Fabric 26.3
- ✅ Quilt 26.3
- ✅ Java 25 required
- ❌ Spigot / CraftBukkit (not supported)

## 📝 Migration

**From v2.4.0 on Paper/Purpur/Folia:**

1. Back up your server and update it to Minecraft 26.3 using Java 25.
2. Remove `DoorsReloaded-2.4.0-Paper.jar` from `plugins/`.
3. Add `DoorsReloaded-2.5.0-Paper.jar`.
4. Restart the server.

**From v2.4.0 on Fabric/Quilt:**

1. Back up your world and update to Minecraft 26.3 using Java 25.
2. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/) `0.19.5` or newer and [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) for Minecraft 26.3.
3. Replace `DoorsReloaded-2.4.0-Fabric.jar` with `DoorsReloaded-2.5.0-Fabric.jar` in `mods/`.
4. Launch the game or restart the server.

releases.notes:
This release adds **Minecraft 26.2 support** and improves configuration safety, Fabric gameplay permissions, door interactions, and the update checker on both platforms.

## ✨ New Features & Changes

- ✅ **Minecraft 26.2 Support** - Updated both the Fabric/Quilt mod and Paper/Purpur/Folia plugin for Minecraft 26.2.
- ✅ **Safer Fabric Configuration** - Invalid configuration files are left untouched, and failed reloads preserve the previous settings. Valid configurations retain their comments and extra keys.
- ✅ **Fabric Gameplay Permissions** - Double doors, knocking, iron doors, and iron trapdoors now respect permission grants and denials, including explicit denials for operators.
- ✅ **Reliable Double Door Interactions** - Fabric double doors synchronize only after successful block use, respecting canceled interactions and sneaking item use. Double-door auto-close also respects the permission decision made when opening the door.
- ✅ **Knocking Behavior Fixes** - Fabric knocking is restricted to survival and adventure mode, and the configured knocking sound category is now loaded correctly.
- ✅ **Folia Update Checker Fix** - Fixed the startup and recurring update-checker scheduler failures reported in [issue #8](https://github.com/Semarina/DoorsReloaded/issues/8). Player notifications now use the player's entity scheduler.
- ✅ **More Reliable Update Checks** - Both platforms select the highest compatible stable Modrinth release for the running Minecraft version and platform. Disabled checks make no requests, and reloads and shutdown clean up polling.

## 📦 Downloads

| Platform | File | Minecraft Version |
|----------|------|-------------------|
| Paper/Purpur/Folia | `DoorsReloaded-2.4.0-Paper.jar` | 26.2 |
| Fabric/Quilt | `DoorsReloaded-2.4.0-Fabric.jar` | 26.2 |

## 🔧 Technical Changes

- Updated Fabric Loom to `1.17.21` and Gradle to `9.6.0`.
- Updated Fabric Loader to `0.19.3` and Fabric API to `0.154.0+26.2`.
- Updated the Paper API target to `26.2.build.48-alpha`.
- Bundled Fabric Permissions API `0.7.0` for Minecraft 26.2.
- Added safe YAML parsing and atomic configuration writes on Fabric.
- Replaced predictive Fabric door handling with hooks around actual block use.
- Added shared update-checking logic with structured JSON parsing and a private daemon worker.
- Register the Paper update notification listener once and apply checker settings on reload.
- Added reproducible release builds, artifact verification, and SHA-256 checksums.
- Passed 18 Fabric unit tests, 13 Paper unit tests, and 9 Fabric server GameTests. Live Folia/Purpur/Quilt gameplay and client visuals have not been verified.

## 📋 Compatibility Summary

- ✅ Paper 26.2
- ✅ Purpur 26.2
- ✅ Folia 26.2 (region-threading aware)
- ✅ Fabric 26.2
- ✅ Quilt 26.2
- ✅ Java 25 required
- ❌ Spigot / CraftBukkit (not supported)

## 📝 Migration

**From v2.3.0 on Paper/Purpur/Folia:**

1. Back up your server and update it to Minecraft 26.2 using Java 25.
2. Remove `DoorsReloaded-2.3.0-Paper.jar` from `plugins/`.
3. Add `DoorsReloaded-2.4.0-Paper.jar`.
4. Restart the server.

**From v2.3.0 on Fabric/Quilt:**

1. Back up your world and update to Minecraft 26.2 using Java 25.
2. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/) `0.19.3` or newer and [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) for Minecraft 26.2.
3. Replace `DoorsReloaded-2.3.0-Fabric.jar` with `DoorsReloaded-2.4.0-Fabric.jar` in `mods/`.
4. Launch the game or restart the server. Legacy Fabric configuration files migrate automatically.

releases.notes:
This release focuses on **massive customizability additions** regarding Trapdoors, Fence Gates, and granular configurations for knocking sounds based on wood/iron/copper materials.

## ✨ New Features & Changes

- ✅ **Fence Gate Support** - You can now knock on fence gates! Handled explicitly by the `allow-knocking-gates` switch.
- ✅ **Iron Door / Trapdoor Customization Split** - `allow-opening-irondoors-with-hands` has been separated into two independent controls:
  - `allow-opening-irondoors-with-hands`
  - `allow-opening-irontrapdoors-with-hands`
- ✅ **Granular Sound Options** - You can assign 9 independently configured knocking sounds (alongside distinct categorized pitch and volume properties):
  - `sound-knock-door-[wood/copper/iron]`
  - `sound-knock-[trapdoor/gate]-[wood/copper/iron]`
- ✅ **Config Restructuring** - Configurations now visibly categorize behavioral interactions vs audio properties (e.g. standardizing `allow-knocking-doors` naming conventions and segregating logic away from Sound configs). Backward compatibility cleanly preserves old values during your transition naturally!

## 📦 Downloads

| Platform | File | Minecraft Version |
|----------|------|-------------------|
| Paper/Purpur/Folia | `DoorsReloaded-2.2.0-Paper.jar` | 1.21+ |
| Fabric/Quilt | `DoorsReloaded-2.2.0-Fabric.jar` | 1.21.11 |

## 🔧 Technical Changes

- Migrated build system from Maven to Gradle
- Multi-module project structure (`paper/` and `fabric/` modules)
- Updated to Gradle 8.14 with Java 21

## 📋 Compatibility Summary

- ✅ Paper 1.21+
- ✅ Purpur 1.21+
- ✅ Folia 1.21+ (region-threading aware)
- ✅ Fabric 1.21.11
- ✅ Quilt 1.21.11
- ❌ Spigot / CraftBukkit (not supported)

## 📝 Migration

**From v2.1.x on Paper/Purpur/Folia:**
1. Remove old `DoorsReloaded.jar` from `plugins/`
2. Drop in `DoorsReloaded-2.2.0-Paper.jar`
3. Restart the server

**New Fabric/Quilt installation:**
1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/) and [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
2. Place `DoorsReloaded-2.2.0-Fabric.jar` in `mods/`
3. Launch the game
